stem: Plant damage is observed shortly after a canopy-work order was completed in the same area. What should the observation record include?
choices: Record the work order as the confirmed cause because the timing and location match
Record the location and pattern of damage, the relevant work-order/shift context, and the escalation status while keeping causality unconfirmed
Record the damage and location now, but omit the work history until a supervisor confirms whether it caused the damage
Record the work-order timing and the damage description, but omit the spatial pattern because the timing already provides the strongest clue
rationale: Relevant work history belongs in the record because it may help later review, but temporal association does not by itself prove cause. The record should preserve both the observed distribution and the contextual event without causal overreach.
